title: Synthetic job intent and request attempts
method: Assume 1,000 intended jobs and 80 additional retry attempts, giving 1,080 attempts. A correct idempotency contract creates 1,000 jobs. The example illustrates the denominator distinction; it is not an observed duplicate rate.
alt: Synthetic job intent and request attempts. Intended jobs: 1000 count; Request attempts: 1080 count. Illustrative inputs.
